name: the-late-city
description: An editorial theme for a two desk publication: Technology reports on what is being built, Philosophy works out what it costs.

masthead_note.description: The line under the wordmark on the front page.
masthead_note.default: We arrive late on purpose. Reporting on what is being built, and arguments about what it is doing to the rest of us.

late_letter_heading.description: The headline of the newsletter section.
late_letter_heading.default: The week does not end when the news does.

late_letter_body.description: The editor's note in the newsletter section.
late_letter_body.default: Every Sunday evening we send one letter: the story we could not stop thinking about, the argument it provoked, and a short note on anything we got wrong. It arrives after the week has finished making noise, which is generally the only time any of it is legible.

late_letter_signature.description: Who signs the letter. Leave empty to omit the signature.

late_letter_fine.description: The small print under the form. Keep it accurate.
late_letter_fine.default: One letter a week. You can unsubscribe from any issue.

contact_email.description: Editorial address for the footer. Leave empty to omit the link.

corrections_email.description: Corrections address. Leave empty to link the standards page instead.

show_reading_time.description: Show the estimated reading time on stories.

show_related_reading.description: Show Related reading at the foot of a story.
